title: Pair failures: reduction to the ideal of nonzero characters, and hardness through inert layers
claim: Let G = N x| C_r with N of exponent p and class c < p, r | p - 1, d | r, and m_d the ideal of n = log N generated by the components of nonzero character mod d. (1) Every homomorphism over a sector of order d from a group with H1(pi; F_p) = 0, and every knot-group homomorphism sending the meridian to tau of order d, lands in exp(m_d) x| C_d; the criterion is unchanged. (2) Inert transfer: if a quotient m_d/k by a C_d-invariant ideal k has a pinned slope-d/p hardness family whose knots carry twisted cohomology only at characters in a set A, and no component of k has a character in A, then counting |Hom(pi_1 S^3_(d/p)(K), G)| is #P-hard, with the total count recovered across sectors by anchor isolation. (3) Instances: a hard pair of m_d/gamma_3(m_d) whose slot characters avoid the characters of gamma_3(m_d) (class-(K) gadget knots at slope d/p), in particular every m_d of class 2; and, for graded n of class at most 4, a graded quotient of m_d satisfying the pair condition with a near triple whose summand roots avoid the characters of the kernel. This recovers the cross-layer theorem of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A. A census of free graded algebras locates the algebras left open (the interacting ones).
failure_conditions: A homomorphism over a sector of order d from a group with H1(pi; F_p) = 0 (or a pinned knot-group homomorphism) that does not land in exp(m_d) x| C_d, i.e. a pinned count for G that differs from the count for exp(m_d) x| C_d.
A knot whose twisted cohomology avoids the characters of k on which pinned counts for G and for the quotient by exp(k) differ.
An algebra listed as satisfying the transfer hypotheses whose ideal, quotient, hard pair or near triple, or kernel characters are not as listed.
foundation_claim_scope: p odd (p >= 5 where the triple construction is used), r | p - 1, N of exponent p and class c < p with a C_r action; manifolds S^3_(d/p)(K) with H1 = Z/d. Cited: the class-(K) theorem and its knot realization (CLASSK-DICHOTOMY-20261026-001A, 001C), the triple construction (COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001A), Lemma I, Bulatov-Grohe via Cai-Chen-Lu. Not covered: interacting pair failures, where every available quotient construction has a kernel component at an active character. r counts the characters of the action, not Boolean variables. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: exact homomorphism counts on S^3_(4/5) surgeries agree for G and exp(m_d) x| C_d on four knots (an algebra with a trivial-character generator, m_d of class 2); where the kernel's characters avoid the knot's active characters, exact counts for G and the quotient differ by exactly p^(nonzero kernel dimension) on five knots, and an interacting control differs; the examples' ideals, lower central series, quotients and kernel characters (cross-layer group at d = 3..9, free class 3 on (1,1) decided exactly at d not in {4, 5}, free class 4 on (1,-1) at d = 5, 7 through gamma_4, a three-generator algebra with m_4 of class 2); a census of 850 free graded algebras: 10 satisfy the criterion everywhere, 511 are hard by the triple theorem at a divisor, 153 residual ones are decided here, 176 are residual and interacting; no human or external review
